datasets.how_obtained_detail: Same 27 as family A but 10 percent of instances of each class replaced by instances from the opposite class; total 54 artificial sets

ir_definition: measured as the ratio of the number of representatives from the largest and the smallest classes

win_claim.quote: Experiments conducted on artificial and real-world imbalanced datasets as well as on challenging applications such as hyperspectral image classification and ImageNet classification establish the efficacy of the proposal.
